tool.name: OpenSwathExport
tool.description: Export scored OpenSWATH results to TSV or Parquet tables
tool.command:
@QUOTE_FOO@ @EXT_FOO@ #import re
## Preprocessing mkdir in && cp '$in' 'in/${gxy_input_basename($in.element_identifier, $in.ext)}' && #if "out_dir_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') mkdir out_dir && #end if
## Main program call
set -o pipefail && @EXECUTABLE@ -write_ctd ./ && python3 '$__tool_directory__/fill_ctd.py' '@EXECUTABLE@.ctd' '$args_json' '$hardcoded_json' && @EXECUTABLE@ -ini @EXECUTABLE@.ctd -in 'in/${gxy_input_basename($in.element_identifier, $in.ext)}' #if "out_dir_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') -out_dir out_dir/ #end if #if len(str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',')) == 0 | tee '$stdout' #end if
## Postprocessing #if "ctd_out_FLAG" in $OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS && mv '@EXECUTABLE@.ctd' '$ctd_out' #end if

param.label: Input scored OpenSWATH result file in OSW format

section.name: parquet
section.title: Options for scored feature parquet export

param.name: run
param.label: Whether to export scored feature parquet tables

param.name: include_transition_data
param.label: Whether to also export transition-level parquet tables

param.name: exclude_decoys
param.label: Whether to exclude decoys from parquet feature exports

param.name: run
param.label: Whether to export the filtered results table

param.name: format
param.label: Output format for the filtered results table

param.name: ipf
param.label: How IPF results should be represented when SCORE_IPF is present

param.name: transition_quantification
param.label: Whether to aggregate transition-level quantification columns

param.name: max_transition_pep
param.label: Maximum transition PEP used for aggregated transition quantification

param.name: ipf_max_peptidoform_pep
param.label: Maximum IPF PEP used for peptidoform export filtering

param.name: max_rs_peakgroup_qvalue
param.label: Maximum run-specific peakgroup q-value retained

param.name: use_peptide_scores
param.label: Whether to append peptide-level scores if SCORE_PEPTIDE is present and to require passing the peptide-level threshold

param.name: max_global_peptide_qvalue
param.label: Maximum global peptide-level q-value retained when peptide filtering is enabled

param.name: use_protein_scores
param.label: Whether to append protein-level scores if SCORE_PROTEIN is present and to require passing the protein-level threshold

param.name: max_global_protein_qvalue
param.label: Maximum global protein-level q-value retained when protein filtering is enabled

param.name: use_gene_scores
param.label: Whether to append gene-level scores if SCORE_GENE is present and to require passing the gene-level threshold

param.name: max_global_gene_qvalue
param.label: Maximum global gene-level q-value retained when gene filtering is enabled

param.name: use_alignment
param.label: Whether to recover aligned features when legacy alignment tables are present

param.name: max_alignment_pep
param.label: Maximum alignment PEP retained when alignment recovery is enabled

param.name: exclude_decoys
